lemmas.statement: Exists rational sos-multipliers s_i, nonneg-products p_i, and polynomial multipliers q_j such that -1 = sum p_i s_i^2 + sum q_j g_j over the 180 residual polynomials g_j, in the real coordinates of a fourth basis completing the MUB(6) triple.

near_misses.claim: The singular Segre slice identity with residual R7 is a Stengle certificate refuting every fourth basis.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: Its separating polynomial equals -1/1000 on the slice by construction, so it is a definitional evaluation, not a certificate. It is NOT_A_CERTIFICATE and is restricted to a slice, not the full variety.

open_obligations: No certificate exists in the checkout; the identity has to be found by an SDP/Groebner search and rationalised exactly.
The 180 residuals g_j are not listed in the provided sources, so they cannot be cited or defined.
No existing declarations were given, so generators, relations and compositions are left empty rather than guessed.
Degree bound and variable set for the multipliers are undetermined.
The Lean statement is a placeholder and needs a real formalisation of MUB(6) residuals over Q or R.
The exact rational verification of the identity is pending.
